_comment: Hand-authored Odoo-style gold (8–12 Qs). Point connection at an Odoo Postgres/SQLite dump with sale.order / res.partner style tables (names vary by version). Placeholder — set ODOO_DB_PATH / connection manually; no DB is checked in.
db_note: Expected tables (illustrative): sale_order, sale_order_line, res_partner, product_product, account_move, stock_quant

items.question: How many sales orders are confirmed?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_order WHERE state = 'sale'

items.question: How many partners (contacts) are in the system?
What is the average sales order amount untaxed?
Which partner has the highest total sales order amount?
items.gold_sql: SELECT partner_id, SUM(amount_total) AS total FROM sale_order GROUP BY partner_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: How many account moves are in draft?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_move WHERE state = 'draft'

items.question: How many sale order lines are there?
How many partners are companies?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM res_partner WHERE is_company = 1 OR is_company = true
